cases.response: Route 4 — Build or modify a Mini App. These five files provide a plain-HTML notes app with no bundler. Both endpoints derive the owner from platform-verified ctx.initData.user.id; listing filters by that owner, and creation ignores client-supplied identities. Notes are trimmed, must contain non-whitespace text, and cannot exceed 2,000 UTF-16 code units before trimming. The browser uses the official callback API, displays text safely, preserves input on errors, and never retries writes automatically. public/ is already the static output folder; no build step is needed. Apply the schema through a reviewed migration before any later publication of its dependent endpoints. No deployment or Telegram contact was performed. Review follow-up: absent SDK/init data leaves controls disabled with a Telegram entry message. A shared callback/try-catch path restores all controls after either asynchronous or synchronous SDK failures. The existing ownership predicates, input bounds, safe text rendering and uncertain-write retry guidance remain in place.
